content: Documented commercial C64 games using undocumented 6502 opcodes: Wizball uses immediate-mode LAX relying on the unstable 'magic constant' byte (assumed $EE by emulators, chip/temperature dependent on real hardware); Boulder Dash, Bomb Jack II, Fort Apocalypse use LAX; Bard's Tale I/II, Marble Madness, Last Ninja, Speedball, Test Drive II, Buggy Boy use SAX. VICE emulates undocumented opcodes with cycle-accurate timing specifically for compatibility with such titles.
